name: Run for Child 2026
short_description: Run for Child 2026 is a 21 km half marathon, 10 km and 5 km charity run on Sunday 15 November 2026 around Bueng Si Than lake at Khon Kaen University.
ai_summary: Run for Child 2026 is a road race on Sunday 15 November 2026 at Bueng Si Than, the lake on the Khon Kaen University campus, organised by K SPORT. It offers a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km, with entries from THB 300 to 600 and a THB 1,000 VIP option. Half-marathon prize money goes three deep overall, with age-group trophies in five-year bands.

core_facts.venue: Bueng Si Than, Khon Kaen University

faqs.question: When and where is Run for Child 2026?
faqs.answer: It is on Sunday 15 November 2026 at Bueng Si Than, the lake on the Khon Kaen University campus in north-east Thailand. The organiser is K SPORT, and entries are taken on the ThaiPhotoRun platform. Start times had not been published on the entry page, so check it and the organiser's Facebook page before race week.

faqs.question: What distances does Run for Child offer and what do they cost?
faqs.answer: Three distances: a 21 km half marathon at THB 600, a 10 km at THB 400 and a 5 km fun run at THB 300, or THB 200 for runners under 19. A VIP entry for any distance costs THB 1,000. Finishers inside the time limit in the 10 km and 21 km receive a medal.

faqs.question: What prizes are there for the half marathon?
faqs.answer: Overall prize money is THB 2,000, 1,500 and 1,000 for the first three men and women. Age-group trophies go five deep in five-year bands from 19-24 up to 70 and over, with cash awards of THB 1,000, 800 and 500 for the top three in each age group, according to the entry page.
